# SaltWatch 2.2.3

This release makes the local SaltWatch interface more consistent and easier to
scan.

## Interface improvements

- Added explicit, task-matched icons to every user-facing entity.
- Added clear visual cues for salt level, calibration distances and actions,
  warning states, diagnostics, refill controls, and firmware maintenance.
- Preserved the existing task-oriented sections and entity ordering.

There are no measurement, calibration, forecast, or connectivity behavior
changes in this release. Existing Wi-Fi credentials, Home Assistant API
encryption, calibration, and forecast data are preserved during the managed
update.
